gaps.sentence: She gave a moving ___ (PERFORM) of the sonata.
gaps.explanation: 'A performance of the sonata' — the act of performing.

gaps.sentence: Rising sea levels ___ (THREAT) the very existence of the island.
gaps.explanation: A main verb is needed after the plural subject: threaten.
'Her confidence' — the noun; 'confident' is the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The shop is under new ___ (MANAGE) from Monday.

gaps.explanation: 'A brief introduction' — the noun from introduce.

gaps.sentence: The charity relies entirely on voluntary ___ (DONATE).
gaps.explanation: 'Voluntary donations' — gifts of money given willingly.
People are satisfied; things are satisfying or satisfactory.
